audit.why: Xerath owns levels 1-6 on range; Mel takes over at items when W reflects his all-projectile kit and E punishes his immobility. Prose matches; noted that diff 'EVEN 5.5/10' sits oddly beside a 41% WR and a 5/7-Xerath chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content chart (Xerath 0-4, Mel 5-6) matches the packet.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-grounded; full sides aligned to them with matching whys.
audit.corrected: Sides, ratings and whys rewritten per row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing: Rite of the Arcane (R) is a channel Mel's Solar Snare cancels outright; Eye of Destruction (W) is the one spell Rebuttal cannot return (no projectile flag — it falls from above) while Q, E and R barrages are all projectiles.
audit.why: Kit flags: xerath R channel + projectile, Q/E projectile, W zone only. Missing-interactions lists channel-interruptible.
Kit: Shocking Orb 13-11, Eye of Destruction 14-10, Arcanopulse 9-5, R 130/115/100.
Farm-safe-then-flip trading plan matches both kits.

edits.before: Q-volley his last-hits — the radiant barrage chips from a range most mids can't answer at one.
edits.after: Xerath's charged Arcanopulse pokes you off last-hits from a range your opening volley can't answer.

edits.before: W online: Rebuttal turns his poke into YOUR poke. The reflect re-prices every projectile in the lane.
edits.after: Rebuttal is online but 38s long — he pokes between glows with Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction.

edits.before: E completes the kit: the snare into full volley is your kill pattern. Hold it for real windows.
edits.after: Shocking Orb completes his kit: every step-up risks the stun into full artillery. Farm behind minions.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — volley every wave contact and bank the overwhelm stacks on his health bar.
edits.after: He controls the wave with 14s Eye of Destruction rotations — take what's safe and bank your stacks.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane adds global chip onto a losing lane — his peak. Hug tower and hold your HP.

edits.before: Luden's spike: snare-volley chunks half bars and the execute cleans the remainder. Force contacts.
edits.after: First item flips it: W reflects Arcanopulse or eats the stun, and your snare ends an immobile mage.

edits.before: Late Mel is a counter-artillery battery: reflect their poke, snare their dive, and execute the chipped.
edits.after: Any flank ends him: reflect the artillery, snare the immobile Xerath, and Golden Eclipse cleans it up.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb: 13s at rank 1 — his only CC; dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. - Eye of Destruction cycles every 14-10s; step up for CS in the gap. - His R (130s) is a channel: your Solar Snare cancels it outright. - Hold W for his full rotation, not one spell.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: His Q cycles every 9-5s and W every 14-10s — volley your own last-hits in those gaps and bank stacks he must answer.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Eye of Destruction falls from above — Rebuttal never returns it; the reflect answers Arcanopulse, Shocking Orb and his R only.
